rules: All eight exact files must be bounded, single-link, non-reparse; extras, missing files and sidecars fail. Scan raw and canonical bytes before database opening.
Manifest hashes exactly six payloads. Publication binds the manifest and timing-evidence bytes under the first-live timing profile.

The external bundle envelope hashes all eight files, including manifest and publication. Its domain-separated commitment excludes only bundle_commitment_sha256. This avoids a manifest/publication self-reference cycle.
Expected bundle and authorization commitments are supplied independently. Self-rehashing an archive is not consent, review approval or source admission.
All envelope and manifest authorization/plan/execution identifiers must match the independently verified direct-control and actual SQLite timing graph.
Derive records and terminal projections from actual immutable SQLite rows; never accept them from the archive as caller-generated replacements.
The archived claim receipt is verified as data. The portable archive verifier does not inspect or provision a local claim store and cannot attest winning-claim ownership or authorize resume.
Re-read the exact eight-file set after all verification. Publication receipt self-write duration is not measured by itself.
Only completed-pair data is supported; partial/quarantine needs a separate successor. Old first-live artifact formats remain unchanged.
Review signatures, independent review digest, exact first-live/campaign source and dependency identity, actual provenance and runtime admission remain external mandatory gates.
